name: manual_25b239
claim: Authenticate and cross-check a complete bounded signed revocation feed before advancing durable freshness. Commit acknowledged denials before freshness so a crash can leave denials ahead of the cache, never the reverse. Restart unavailable until explicit refresh; missing history or rollback must refuse rather than silently resetting the durable floor.
